scopeNote: Zero real model and native turns. Only B-owned paths touched. No second ledger/coordinator/lifecycle, no second database, no new Driver, no price/recipe research. Twelve user instances untouched. Two historical report diffs preserved. Shared probe outputs go to /tmp.

B1_receiver_reached.what_changed: the spawned Runner process is now genuinely observed receiving begin; all earlier waves reported begin=0
B1_receiver_reached.howCounted: the Runner process itself appends every frame it receives to PA_RUNNER_RECEIVER_LOG before any admission check; the count therefore comes from the receiving process, not from the caller's bookkeeping

twoB_ownedEnablers.change: optional PA_RUNNER_RECEIVER_LOG append of every received command; inert when unset
PA_RUNNER_SCENARIO overrides the scenario argv; argv stays authoritative when unset

B1_receiver_reached.lane: Codex Driver against the B-owned in-process fake app-server (codex-fake); no installed Codex executed

B1_join_to_application.detail: the product Application/Broker vertical and this receiver are still two separately proven halves. Joining them is exactly the business reconnect port (B2).
B1_join_to_application.what_was_attempted: createProductRuntime with a native NativeProductConfiguration, native profile matching the create_work profileId, so the product would spawn NativeProductAttempt itself
B1_join_to_application.blockerObserved: main's NativeProductAttempt completes its environment/preparation handshake before sending begin; with no environment plan the prepared promise never resolves, and codex-fake sets eagerPrepare=false. No main product class was edited, per the packet.
B1_join_to_application.conclusion: the native product attempt prepared (works/ticket/link/binding rows exist) but produced no begin because the handshake never completed; this is a real missing product-side hook, not a fabricated result
